note: The Fenbridge muster standard (Balgath loot): ONE GLB, root Muster_Standard with Standard_Pole, the Standard_Banner pivot (cloth child Standard_Banner_Cloth) and Standard_Finial. The raw GLB comes from the deterministic Blender factory scripts/assets/muster_standard/model.py, driven by export_muster_standard.mjs, which stamps the source fingerprint and runs this spec. Vertex-coloured, texture-free (no KTX2 step), original work with no reference image.
